text.tspan: Day 0 — intake and planning, minutes not weeks
and is an AI service. When ambiguous, tier up.
Day 0 — the fleet asks permission before it speaks to an outsider
Days 1 and 2 — replies arrive in fragments, evidence is screened
Day 3 — scoring and the human gate
Three weeks of calendar review compressed to about three days, and roughly
fifty analyst hours to under one. Vendor reply latency is the floor — the fleet adds none of its own.

svg.text: Submit NimbusWrite AI, processes customer text, 40k per year
publish review.intake
deliver intake event
recall dossier from Memory Bank, tier the vendor
publish review.plan_ready with checkpointed plan
deliver plan_ready
select and tailor 60 questions from the bank
gateway blocks send — policy P1 requires an approval token
approval card — the review parks in GATED, gate_scope contact, for human gate G2
one tap authorises first contact
signed single-use token, scope email
questionnaire, under idempotency key questionnaire_send v1
partial replies and a SOC 2 report
extract locally, then SCREEN first so SDP sees real data, then scrub
chunk, embed and index the stamped text — only stamped content is indexed
publish evidence.screened with a verdict-bearing clean-stamp
deliver reply events
parse incrementally, merge by question id, record confidence
chase round 2 on schedule, its own idempotency key chase round2
deliver screened evidence
pass 1 Flash — extract control claims
retrieve top-k passages per claim from the KNN index
deterministic checks in Python — expiry, staleness, scope, auditor (source=rule)
pass 3 Pro — reconcile claims against the retrieved passages (source=model)
findings ready, MFA claim contradicts SOC 2 exception, severity high
reassess_tier — a Q23 answer widens the declared data scope
re-tier 2 to 1, plan_version incremented, extra domain's questions sent
deliver findings_ready
deterministic rubric arithmetic in Python — no model call in scoring
one Pro call writes the CISO memo
screen the memo through drawbridge-output before a human reads it
Trust Score 71 of 100, band conditional, memo and score breakdown
gate card with findings and reasoning
approve with conditions, identity and timestamp recorded
publish review.approved
close the review, write the dossier to Memory Bank
audit binder available for export
Drawbridge — J1: a Tier-1 vendor review, intake to approval
